description: Land Acquisition - Keenawa & Diwullepitiya, Kotawehera D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land lots to be acquired, including lot numbers, land names, owners, extents, and boundaries. The content is entirely focused on land and property matters, specifically government acquisition of land for public purposes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). There is no government personnel information, organizational changes, or other specialized content that would warrant a different classification.
